sentences.en: Please, can you indicate this to me on the map?
sentences.zh: 请在地图上标示一下这个地方。

sentences.en: Her questions indicate that she understands the subject very well.
sentences.zh: 她的提问表明她对这个主题非常了解。

sentences.en: The details of the agreement are indicated in the contract.
sentences.zh: 协议的具体细节在合同中有所说明。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（加以…）+dic（说）+ ate（做） →说出→表示，表明
